Lena (Product): quick sync, we promised Nimbus a pilot: prewarm + BYOK + 99th <350ms. need clear dependency map. who calls longest lead?
Arjun (PM): Nimbus timeline = 5 weeks. acceptance: p99 target, BYOK rotation test, and staging smoke on 5 tenants.
Tess (Runtime): runtime needs: prewarm hook, tenant-scoped KV, health endpoint for warm state. prewarm depends on infra signal to allocate GPUs ~2m before traffic.
Omar (Infra): infra tasks: VPC peering, reserved GPU quotas, and outbound rules for KMS. quota increases are the slowest (could be 7 bd).
Priya (Security): BYOK/KMS review is gating. need vendor attestation, retention policy, and IAM matrix. estimate 8 bd after packet.
Becky (Eng): eng work = feature flagged tenant isolation + test harness. ~2.5w. can start mocks in parallel.
Ian (SRE): need tenant SLOs, synthetic cold-start probes, and rollback routing (route to hosted var). I'll draft runbook.
Arjun (PM): proposed parallel plan: security packet + quota request ASAP. infra to open peering ticket. runtime/eng spike mocked prewarm.
Tess (Runtime): i'll post a short design tonight with health endpoint: GET /t/{id}/warm -> {"warm":true|false}.
Omar (Infra): opened ticket INFRA-382 (peering + quota). linking security packet.
ticket-bot: Created ticket INFRA-382 by Omar.
Priya (Security): received ticket link. starting attestation checklist.
Lena (Product): action items: 1) Priya: KMS review (8bd). 2) Omar: quota + peering (3bd for peering prep). 3) Becky/Tess: mock prewarm + RFC (EOW). 4) Ian: runbook stub (2bd). react :white_check_mark: when acked.
Becky (Eng): acked :white_check_mark:. posting RFC link when ready.
Ian (SRE): will add canary thresholds (p99 >350ms -> 5% traffic fallback) and post runbook draft tomorrow.
Lena (Product): callout: if vendor attestation fails we fallback to hosted BYOK shim. next sync Thurs 9am.
